description: §7.6 (S479): the capable form — app reads lib.scrml's file-scope `let` and writes it through `setShared`, a function lib.scrml exports (§66.19) — is clean.
rationale: §7.6: "A file-scope `let` is written only in the file that declares it (S479) … A write of it from another file — through a named import, an `as` alias or a namespace import (§21.3), and in any write form … — SHALL be a compile error, **`E-FILE-SCOPE-LET-FOREIGN-WRITE`**." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — #1962 file-scope questions 1–4 + `parseVariant` duplicate keys, PA recs adopted" item 3. An import makes the binding readable; the declaring file's exported function writes it.
